_comment: Who wears which mark in front of their name.
This copy is the one inside the jar and is only the starting point. The
client refreshes it from the same file on the repository's main branch, so
changing who has what needs a commit rather than a release.
rank is one of: standard, dev, owner, vip.
uuid wins where it is given, because a name can be changed by anybody and
a uuid cannot. An entry with only a name still works and is matched case
insensitively - it is the convenient form, not the safe one.
